outcome: percentage of mothers with knowledge about colostrum feeding
percentage of mothers aware of breastfeeding benefits
percentage of mothers aware of exclusive breastfeeding duration
percentage of mothers with positive attitude towards breastfed babies
cohort: The study included primiparous lactating mothers admitted to the postnatal ward of a tertiary care teaching hospital.
finding: While most primiparous mothers demonstrated knowledge of colostrum feeding and breastfeeding benefits, and a positive attitude, a notable proportion lacked awareness regarding the recommended duration of exclusive breastfeeding, suggesting existing misconceptions.
cross-section timing: During the postnatal period, while mothers were admitted to the hospital's postnatal ward.
